question: Which of the following devices can function as both input and output devices?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Touch Screen**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• A **touch screen** is an electronic display that can act as both an **input and output device**.
 
• As an input device, it allows users to interact with the system by touching the screen using a finger or stylus.
 
• As an output device, it displays visual content, such as text, images, or videos, similar to a regular screen or monitor.
 
• Touch screens are commonly used in smartphones, tablets, ATMs, interactive kiosks, and other digital devices.
 
• They employ various technologies such as resistive, capacitive, infrared, or surface acoustic wave to detect and process touch inputs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Resistive Touch Screen:**

 
 
• It uses two electrically conductive layers separated by a small gap.
 
• When pressure is applied to the screen, the layers come into contact, registering the touch input.
 
• Commonly used in older devices and ATM machines.
 
 
 
• **Capacitive Touch Screen:**
 
 
• It works by sensing the electrical conductivity of the user's finger.
 
• Capacitive screens are more responsive and support multi-touch gestures.
 
• They are widely used in smartphones and modern tablets.
 
 
 
• **Infrared Touch Screen:**
 
 
• This technology uses infrared light beams to detect touch.
 
• It does not require physical contact; even proximity can register input.
 
• Typically found in interactive kiosks and large touch displays.
 
 
 
• **Surface Acoustic Wave (SAW) Touch Screen:**
 
 
• SAW screens rely on ultrasonic waves that pass over the touch screen surface.
 
• When the screen is touched, the waves are absorbed, allowing the location of the touch to be determined.
 
• They provide high clarity and durability but are sensitive to external contaminants.
 
 
 
• **Applications of Touch Screens:**
 
 
• Touch screens are widely used in **retail stores, healthcare, education, gaming, and industrial automation.**
 
• They enable intuitive user experiences, reducing the need for external peripherals like keyboards or mice.
